recent_posts.text: 21 July 2021 marks the 100th anniversary of Billy Mitchell’s infamous sinking of the battleship Ostfriesland. This dramatic event, in defiance of the Navy’s restriction, proved the value of airpower. This demonstration and the further efforts of Mitchell led to the birth of the Air Force as a Service that could deploy combat effects to any battlefield. I highly recommend reading more on this ardent airpower advocate. Now, I challenge all Space Force professionals to find the newest weapon system that will undeniably put them on par or superior to the other Services delivering combat effects. To quote Mitchell’s Congressional testimony, “It is a very serious question whether airpower is auxiliary to the Army and Navy, or whether armies and navies are not actually auxiliary to airpower.” We must all continue to promote the value of spacepower within our own community, the rest of DOD and the public. It might make your career a bit more difficult, but how cool is it that we’re able to do something today that people will remember a century from now!
